title: Parameterized D-torsors in differential Galois theory
summary: In the context of differential fields of characteristic zero with several commuting derivations, we discuss the notion of $\#$-differential equations on parameterized D-torsors and their associated Galois extensions. Using model-theoretic methods, we observe that any generalized strongly normal extension (in the sense of Pillay [14] and, more generally, León Sánchez [9]) is the Galois extension of a parameterized D-torsor.
